title: 12 Best Food Markets in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's top 12 food markets, from the vibrant Zelyony Bazaar to modern food halls. Find fresh produce, local delicacies, and gourmet treats for every budget and taste.

places.name: Zelyony Bazaar (Green Bazaar)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kumys (fermented mare's milk), Kurt (dried salty cheese balls), fresh apricots (in season), and a hearty plov from one of the small eateries.

places.name: Saryarka Bazaar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh berries (strawberries, raspberries in summer), local honey, and smoked fish.

places.name: Ortaлык (Central) Bazaar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any fresh meat for shashlik (skewered meat), various types of dried apricots and nuts, and local tea blends.

places.name: Dostyk Plaza Food Hall
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Craft burgers from 'Burger King's' premium selection (not the fast food chain) or contemporary dishes from 'Cafe Central'.

places.name: Kompas Food Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked sourdough bread, specialty coffee, and a selection of local cheeses.

places.name: Tast Food Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kimchi Fried Rice from a Korean stall, or a fresh smoothie from one of the healthy drink vendors.

places.name: Mega Center Alma-Ata Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A combo meal from a local fast-food chain like 'Burger King Kazakhstan' (their local menu often has interesting additions) or a traditional soup from a Kazakh stall.

places.name: Mega Park Food Hall
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vietnamese pho from a specialty stall or a slice of cake from a European-style patisserie.

places.name: Esentai Gourmet (within Esentai Mall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Artisanal cheeses, freshly prepared salads from the deli, or imported chocolates.

places.name: Kalkaman Bazaar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked nan bread, a kilogram of seasonal apples from local orchards, or a simple lagman from a small stall.

places.name: Magnum ATAK Hypermarket (Ryskulov Ave)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked pastries, a variety of cold cuts and cheeses from the deli, or any seasonal fruit on display.

places.name: Aport Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic pepperoni pizza from one of the many pizzerias or a set menu from a Chinese fast-food vendor.
